content.title: Validate configurable branch feature
content.description:
Validate the --branch flag implementation for agt init.

## What to test
1. **Default behavior preserved** — agt init (no --branch) creates _agentrack branch, .agentrack/ dir, config.json with no branch field
2. **Custom branch** — agt init --branch testing creates _testing branch, .testing/ dir, config.json has branch: _testing
3. **Normalization** — --branch _ci and --branch ci both produce _ci branch and .ci/ dir
4. **Push/pull respect config** — After init with --branch, push and pull operate on the correct branch/directory
5. **Error cases**:
   - Invalid characters in branch name → INVALID_BRANCH_NAME error
   - Empty branch name → error
   - Existing directory conflict → appropriate error
6. **Backward compatibility** — Existing repos with _agentrack and no branch field in config continue to work
7. **Multiple instances** — Can init two separate branches in the same repo

## Reference
Spec: .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md
Implementation issue: mpe3seanai
